description: The top live yield offers for one asset (5 by default, up to 20) in BitcoinYield's own order: rate and risk together, with offers that have a month of steady history and $10M+ of liquidity first. Each offer carries its platform, chain, product type, reported rate (APY or APR), organic versus incentive split, 30-day average, liquidity, A-D risk grade with its main reasons, US availability, investor access, the platform's own deposit link and the page to cite. Filter by chain or a risk ceiling. Use it to compare options; list_yields gives one pick per asset. Rates are variable and not advice. No key required.

asset.description: The asset's symbol, e.g. BTC, USDC or USDE.

chain.description: Only offers on this chain, e.g. Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum or Solana (case-insensitive). Centralized (CeFi) offers have no chain.

limit.description: How many offers to return, 1 to 20 (default 5).

max_risk.description: Only offers graded at or below this letter: A (lower risk), B (moderate), C (elevated), D (higher).

name: list_offers

degraded_sources.description: The sources missing from this snapshot, if any.

access.description: An investor restriction: KYC, Accredited only or Invite only.

avg_30d.description: The rate's 30-day average; null under a month of history.

chain.description: The chain the offer is on; null for a centralized (CeFi) offer.

durability.description: Today's rate against its 30-day average: durable, moderate, volatile or spiking; posted when it has not moved in 30 days (a rate the platform sets); insufficient under a month of history.

earn_url.description: Where to deposit: the platform's own page.

liquidity_usd.description: The liquidity a depositor can exit into, in US dollars; null when the source reports none (custodial desks).

market.description: The vault, market or token the rate is paid in.

partner.description: True when BitcoinYield may earn a commission through earn_url (it never changes the order).

platform.description: The platform's name, e.g. Aave V3.

product_type.description: How the yield is produced, e.g. DeFi lending, Savings rate or Liquid staking.

rank.description: The offer's place in BitcoinYield's order (rate and risk together), 1 first.

rate.description: The reported annual rate in percent (5.2 means 5.2%).

rate_base.description: The organic part of the rate (interest, fees, staking), before incentive rewards.

rate_basis.description: Whether the source reports the rate as APY (compounded) or APR; unknown when it does not say.

rate_rewards.description: The part paid as incentive rewards, which last only as long as someone funds them.

rewards_program.description: Who pays rate_rewards and how far ahead it is funded, when the incentive program is known (Merkl campaigns on Morpho, Euler, Aave and Fluid); null otherwise.

funded_through.description: Last day (UTC, YYYY-MM-DD) the live round is funded through.

rounds.description: Rounds in that run, the live one included (1 = never renewed yet).

since.description: First day (UTC) of the unbroken run of rounds the live one belongs to.

risk_reasons.description: The main factors behind the grade.

risk_tier.description: BitcoinYield's A-D risk grade: A lower risk, D higher.

us_available.description: Whether a US retail user can open it.

partial.description: True when a data source was missing from this snapshot.

stale.description: True when part of this snapshot is over 6 hours old (a scheduled refresh was missed).

updated_at.description: When the feed was last refreshed (ISO 8601). It refreshes every 3 hours.

url.description: The asset's full comparison on BitcoinYield.

title: List the top live offers for one asset
